items.desc: Daily and weekly task manager: startup popup reminder, a marquee strip above the composer, one-click circle completion, editable task cards, and a Sunday AI weekly summary, plus a sidebar DeepSeek API usage widget with balance card, today/cumulative tokens and cost, per-model breakdown and a 7-day chart. items.name: dsh-ditto

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-plan-board

items.name: dsh-daily
items.desc: Daily brief for DeepSeek Harness. Every day at a fixed hour it ranks the plugin market by real install counts and stars, cross-checks it against your own agent memory and working conventions, and proposes two kinds of item: concrete deltas on the plugins people actually use (original does A, the proposal does B) and directions nobody has built yet. The popularity numbers come from the catalog the market itself publishes and are quoted into the prompt rather than guessed; an entry the market has not measured is shown as unmeasured, never as zero. Approving an item opens a new session named after it and hands that session a fixed delivery contract — implement independently, never fork, test green before publishing. Rejected sources are remembered so they stop coming back.

items.name: dsh-den
items.desc: A resident assistant for DeepSeek Harness that is deliberately not another chat box: one floating window plus one standing conversation, both independent of every other session. The heartbeat is held back by four gates — an authority grant, a daily turn budget, quiet hours and a pacing cooldown — and it keeps working across restarts through a lease it has to hold. Each wake is decided by a model that must answer SKIP or a short message, so silence is a decision rather than a failure. The window shows the standing conversation's real message flow, read from the host session store, or from the on-disk session log when the host does not publish that session, and it can send into that conversation directly. den carries the same reach as the person it stands in for, with one limit: read-only. It may read every session, this machine and work channels such as GitHub, but it does not write, send or publish, it never asks anyone for permission, and it never gates another session's tool calls. `npm run digest:github` turns GitHub notifications and your own open pull requests into three Chinese sections — waiting on you, waiting on your review, and yours — with reply drafts that are explicitly marked as unsent.

items.desc: Goal lifecycle management for dsh with an interactive kanban board: goals, criteria, attempts and reviews live in the workspace, driven by graph_* tools, with a two-lane board rendered in the conversation view.

items.name: dsh-teams-x
items.desc: Orchestrates durable multi-agent teams from one DSH session: a captain spawns member subagents, drives a dependency-aware task DAG with quality gates, and coordinates through persistent mailboxes, with a live activity panel.

items.name: dsh-subagent-profile
items.desc: Dispatch subagents with named profiles (model, reasoning effort, and tool scope per task), safety checks, cost estimation with savings comparison, and a full dispatch decision ledger.

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-cron-board
items.desc: Cron job board: schedules local scripts or dsh session tasks (fresh or pinned sessions) by cron expression, with centralized environment-variable management, run logs, and concurrency and timeout control.

items.name: dsh-qa
items.desc: QA project workbench for dsh: manage test projects, requirements, test cases, defects, milestones, reports and approval gates through a browser UI and 18 QA-domain tools.

items.name: dsh-roundtable#ui-roundtable
items.desc: Multi-agent roundtable discussion: each member runs as a subagent on its own model and speaks in turn, a host summarizes each round, and termination writes meeting-minutes Markdown.

items.name: dsh-mcp-relay
items.desc: Expose a running DeepSeek Harness instance over MCP, so an external agent can list, create and continue that instance's own sessions, delegate a turn and collect its result, answer the questions the DSH agent asks, and set how future approval requests resolve.

items.name: dsh-squad
items.desc: Cross-workspace worker fleets: one orchestrating session spawns named worker sessions in other project workspaces, queues or steers tasks into them, watches them in the background via a real host job, and collects their reports. Worker completions deliver themselves to the orchestrator's session rather than needing to be polled, so an idle orchestrator still reacts. Escalations and failed workers deliver by steer when the orchestrator is mid-turn and by queue when it is idle; a turn that ends without a report counts as a failure and the worker is replaced after a configurable limit. The roster persists to disk and each worker session carries a durable title, so a restart neither loses the fleet nor spawns duplicate sessions. Ships five agent presets at full plugin parity with the standard preset.

items.name: oh-my-dsh-slim
items.desc: Match your models and token budgets to each role, then let DSH delegate specialized subagents by task type. Covers architecture analysis, UI/UX, code implementation, codebase exploration, and documentation research, with automatic setup plus per-role reasoning effort and tool permissions.

items.name: dsh-external-agents
items.desc: External Agent control plane for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor Agent, and Antigravity adapters with settings and background job visibility.

items.name: dsh-claude
items.desc: Runs Claude Code as a DSH conversation while preserving its native agent loop, tools, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations.

items.name: dsh-expert-group
items.desc: Role-based expert subagents for DeepSeek Harness with a task sidebar: explorer, librarian, oracle, designer and fixer delegate in parallel, each with its own model and reasoning depth.

items.name: dsh-gme-test-generator
items.desc: Drives the GME Test Agent from inside Harness: three tools list interface catalogs, start and repair autonomous test generation in a local Python backend, poll the task until review, and keep PR, skip and cleanup actions behind explicit user consent.

items.name: dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine
items.desc: An approval-gated OME engineering delivery preset with session-isolated lifecycle evidence.

items.name: dsh-scheduled-send
items.desc: Scheduled send: fire a drafted message into the bound conversation as a normal user bubble at a set time. Runs host-side, so the browser can stay closed; per-session isolation and restart-safe redelivery.

items.name: dsh-task-splitter
items.desc: Host-side long-task detection for small-context local models: long outputs are scaffolded into a parts skeleton (one part per reply, then assemble), and multi-step work into a PLAN.md ledger with notes/ (plan first, one step per reply). Detection is heuristic and host-side, so it does not depend on the model judging its own limits.

items.name: deep-read-summarize
items.desc: Deep reading & summarization for DSH: books/papers/videos/web into structured Obsidian notes via plugin parsers, MapReduce parallel deep-read subagents, JSON Schema outputs and an idempotent cache.

items.name: dsh-research-report
items.desc: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness with a content-addressed evidence ledger, versioned sealed reports where every claim carries a verification verdict and the manifest hash seals the directory, and retrieval orchestration that reuses the ctx.web and ctx.jobs seams.

items.name: dsh-team-rooms
items.desc: Persistent, cross-session multi-agent team rooms for DeepSeek Harness — members, a message bus, a shared task board, and a shared timeline that survive restarts.

items.name: dsh-batch-triage
items.desc: Deterministic ticket triage: a rule prefilter classifies clear cases and returns everything else as needs_review instead of guessing.

items.name: dsh-workflow-canvas
items.desc: Visual drag-and-drop workflow builder for DSH — orchestrate tool calls, sub-agents, and conditional branches on a React Flow canvas.

items.name: dsh-workproof#dsh-delivery-receipts
items.desc: Session-scoped delivery receipts for local artifacts: compare current file hashes with a recorded baseline, keep agent claims separate from explicit user acceptance, flag changed or unavailable files, and export a Markdown receipt through a tool, slash command, and conversation panel.

items.name: dsh-workproof#dsh-evidence-ledger
items.desc: Session-scoped research evidence ledger with sources, linked claims, open questions, and explicit user review; provides a tool, slash command, and conversation panel, with selected-claim Markdown export that omits excerpts, review notes, and local paths by default; does not fetch sources or verify their truth.

items.name: dsh-notes-plugin#dsh-notes-plugin
items.desc: Local Markdown notes as governable working memory for DeepSeek Harness agents: dual-mode source/WYSIWYG editor with images, convention or reference notes auto-inject into the system prompt with sensitive values masked, plus snapshot version history, recycle bin, undoable archiving, AI reorganization, backlinks and full-text search. Compatible with DSH 0.1.7-0.2.x.

items.name: task-board-plugin#dsh-agent-board
items.desc: Kanban task board for DeepSeek Harness sessions: the main agent dispatches tasks to one-shot worker/verifier subagents, with dependency scheduling, file-level exclusion locks, arbitration hold/freeze, milestone progress reporting, and per-task token usage stats.

items.name: dsh-punky-swarm#dsh-punky-swarm
items.desc: Engine-enforced guardrails for DeepSeek Harness agent swarms: quality gates reject half-done work, crash-safe checkpoints resume in place — keeps AI teams from breaking, not just running.

items.name: dsh-subagent-watchdog
items.desc: Automatically continues a native continuable DSH subagent once when it ends with explicit max-tokens termination, then stops.

items.name: dsh-darwin#forge
items.desc: Self-evolution actuator: consumes problem tickets mined from session logs, synthesizes skill candidates (zero-code tiers by default) behind an eval gate with hold-out canaries, then promotes to project .dsh/skills with human confirm and deterministic rollback.

items.name: dsh-more-agent-presets
items.desc: More agent presets for DSH, derived from other coding agents such as Qwen Code and iFlow.

items.name: dsh-workspace-monitor
items.desc: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that periodically detects added, modified, and deleted files in a workspace and reports the changes.

items.name: dsh-image-gen
items.desc: Optimized fork of dsh-image-gen with batch generation (count), gallery pagination, lazy loading, fetch retry/timeout, and 7 providers: Gemini/OpenAI/Seedream/DashScope/Agnes/GLM-Image/Stability AI.

items.name: recowork#recowork-dsh
items.desc: Creates and inspects RecoWork local-agent-project workspaces through two bounded DSH tools and a web workspace card.

items.name: rex-harness#ui-workflow
items.desc: Turns a product or UI request into an implementation-ready design spec with /ui-workflow and /ui-rerun. Analysts run through a read-only ui_analyst tool, and the lead agent writes docs/ui-workflow reports.

items.name: dsh-focus-supervisor#dsh-plugin
items.desc: DSH self-discipline companion with recurring tasks, a gaze-tracking desktop mascot, evidence logs, final AI review, reminders, and window intervention on Windows and GNOME Wayland.

items.name: sandbase-harness
items.desc: Connects dsh to a local SandBase Harness runtime over stdio MCP for managing agents and sessions, streaming turns, inspecting artifacts and cancelling work.

items.name: dsh-tick
items.desc: Session-local scheduled tasks: inject a prompt into the current session after a delay, at a fixed time, or on a repeating interval, so the model wakes up and runs it on time. Manage them from a panel above the composer, the /schedule command, or seven model-facing tools. Timers freeze while DSH is closed and never auto-resume; pause keeps the remaining time, so resuming continues from where it stopped.

items.name: 1acp#acp-service
items.desc: Persistent Codex, Grok Build and Claude Code sessions through ACP, with native model controls, permission approvals and optional A2A delegation.

items.name: dsh-grokbot-dispatch
items.desc: Bidirectional dispatch for DSH: opens visible desktop sessions for tasks dispatched in by Grok Bot / Yobiru, adds /dispatch-grok and /dispatch-zcode slash commands to send tasks out, and reports the session result back to the dispatching peer on completion (peers are user-configured; nothing is sent until configured).

items.name: dsh-multitask
items.desc: A Multitask agent preset where the main conversation only plans, briefs subagents and summarizes results, while file reads, commands, search and builds run inside subagent contexts; four worker kinds, an approval gate for dangerous operations, and zero changes to DSH source.

items.name: agent relay
items.desc: Cross-session task relay for DSH Desktop 0.2: six relay_* control tools, independent sidebar sessions, live host-origin discovery, durable turn-completion checks, and a bundled relay skill.

items.name: kaipu-dsh-plugin-release#plugin-platform
items.desc: An audit workspace for DeepSeek Harness: a multi-agent consultation venue where each review seat is filled by an agent, every judgment is routed to a named review face, and the whole run is kept as a traceable record. Works out of the box: the service endpoint is built in, a workspace is provisioned automatically on first launch, and review scenes come with their seats and agents listed.

items.name: kaipu-dsh-plugin-release#plugin-workstation
items.desc: Companion operations panel for the Kaipu site plugin: round timeline, run status, jump gates and browser entry. Installs and uninstalls on its own; the site plugin stays fully usable without it. Renders the persisted workstation state (no live stream yet).

items.name: dsh-novel-workbench
items.desc: A full-screen novel-writing workbench: chapter board, draft candidates reviewed and merged paragraph by paragraph, plot summaries carrying an index header, and a writing pack assembled from the outline, character cards and earlier chapters. It also reads a shelf of finished books you import, extracts their writing habits in one run, merges them into a single style standard, and puts that standard in the prompt for every later generation.

items.name: dsh-image-gen
items.desc: Native conversational image generation for DeepSeek Harness: ask the agent to create an image, and it handles generation and keeps the result directly in the conversation.

items.name: narrative-prompt-polish
items.desc: ✨ One-click prompt polisher for the DSH composer — an agent refines your rough draft in a side chat over multiple turns, and you copy the result back when you're happy.

items.name: dsh-thincoder-suite
items.desc: Advisor reviews that converge over rounds, an engineering mode whose writes require a design token, escalation of a task to a stronger model, and parallel multi-model consultation; a settings page edits the model routes, timeouts and budgets.

items.name: dsh-novel-craft
items.desc: A novel-writing workbench for DeepSeek Harness: you tap thumbs-up or thumbs-down on candidate passages, and the model distils them into a short preference profile that carries into later drafting calls while the manuscript stays out of the drafting context. Adds a chapter board, per-chapter writing packs, annotation-scoped revision that rewrites only the annotated paragraph and verifies the rest byte-for-byte, a project ledger, and local pacing checks.

items.name: dsh-tool-workflow-plus
items.desc: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official workflow tool: a verbatim fork of the stock tool plus a persisted saved-workflow library (workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete / workflow_run_saved) backed by ctx.storageDomain, so scripts can be stored, retrieved and re-run with new arguments.

items.name: routinekit
items.desc: Capture selected DSH, local MCP, or native WebMCP calls as reviewed, parameterized routines, expose typed tools, and replay with fresh approval.

items.name: dsh-study-desk
items.desc: Study workbench for exam prep and research: three-column task board with tags and filters, a spaced-repetition queue (simplified SM-2) that keeps finished cards coming back, a heatmap lit by actual focused minutes, weekly reports, per-day review notes, a pomodoro timer that survives panel switches, and Markdown export/import for Obsidian. Installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-study-desk on npm).

items.name: dsh-plugin-list-sync
items.desc: Synchronizes DeepSeek Harness third-party plugin lists through S3-compatible storage with diff preview, local snapshots, rollback, and optional LLM provider configuration sync.

items.name: jimu
items.desc: Jimu (积木): domain-based orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness — domain_plan confirmation, per-domain sub-agents with hand-off, and automatic LLM audit.

items.name: dsh-cron
items.desc: Host-side unattended job scheduler: runs one-shot agent tasks or shell commands on cron, interval, or one-time schedules, with persisted at-most-once dispatch state, overlap/misfire policies, and bounded run history.

items.name: dsh-suite
items.desc: All-in-one combo patch for STARDUSTLC's 18 DSH plugins: one command injects shared default configs across office, media, DevOps and notification presets; each component installs directly via a one-line add command (flat design, no git subdependencies).

items.name: xingyuan-dsh
items.desc: Agent preset bundle for wish and task management: create wishes or tasks from conversation, opportunity-day check-ins, micro-actions, plus a memory store and progress charts in the web UI.

items.name: statedock-plugins#deepseek-harness
items.desc: Provides shared plan, context pickup, and progress update Skills through StateDock Remote MCP without executing tasks or scheduling agents; targets Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.

items.name: dsh-complex-project-preset
items.desc: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: the standard tool stack plus four working rules written into the persona prompt — a project keeps at most four documents (intro, decisions, change log, current state and next steps), those documents describe only the current state with no AI edit history or superseded decisions, no git commit or push or pull request until the user explicitly asks, and a careful-coding workflow (restate the goal and done-criteria first, surgical diffs, evidence before claiming success) with plain-language reports.

items.name: dsh-cliworker-now
items.desc: Multi-CLI worker sidebar for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with task dispatch, live conversation views, stop and follow-up controls, and custom role presets.

items.name: dsh-collab-dev
items.desc: Saves architecture and validated plans, runs native AgentTeams workers with approval, parallel coding and independent review, and summarizes progress and verification results.

items.name: dsh-sparkos
items.desc: Self-media workbench plugin: 8-tab dashboard (daily brief, narrative lines, topics, drafts, knowledge-card distill review, sources, publish, advice) with hard guards (48h window, event dedup, card/line existence, read-only advice) and a read-only intel module following the four red lines.

items.name: dsh-tauri-monitor
items.desc: Generic monitor plugin for DSH Desktop: an HTTP polling rule engine. Poll any endpoint on schedule (multi-step, variable extraction, JS condition expressions); when conditions hit, wake a visible agent session to act — zero model calls otherwise. Configure everything in a sidebar GUI panel: create/edit/pause/test/fire-now/run history, same UX as the built-in scheduler plugin.

items.name: dsh-dpia-workbench
items.desc: Adds a versioned DPIA workbench to DeepSeek Harness for source-linked facts, follow-up answers, reassessment, and reviewable reports. Needs Python 3.9+ with `python-docx`, `pypdf`, and (for PDF templates) `reportlab` + `pdftoppm`.

items.name: dsh-littlestar-meeting
items.desc: Cross-session meeting room for DSH: a host session opens a room with a topic and a round limit, invites other sessions in order, they speak one at a time, and the meeting closes with written minutes.

items.name: dsh-agent-studio
items.desc: Visually configure an agent's prompt, tools, visible skills, subagents and fallback models, and assemble several of them into a team. It never writes or edits any host preset file.

items.name: dsh-kanban-flow
items.desc: Agent-driven kanban board: one board per workspace, per-task agent sessions, and a guarded human/agent workflow (Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done).

items.name: dsh-openreelbench
items.desc: Gated four-stage video pipeline: brief, script, assets and compose, turning one sentence into a narrated explainer with ComfyUI workflows or image/video APIs and FFmpeg assembly.

items.name: dsh-novel-solo
items.desc: "Single-Core Writing" plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Thoroughly tool-streamlined and output-hardened for quantized small models, suitable for running long-novel pipelines locally with on-device models.

items.name: agentflow
items.desc: Lifecycle orchestration engine for AI agent teams with task-scoped Git worktree isolation, state-gated delivery transitions, and off-context memory.

items.name: dsh-taskboard
items.desc: Full local-first issue board embedded in the DSH web GUI: Kanban / list / Gantt / workflow / dashboard views, AI chat per task, attachments and labels, auto-claim of todo tasks driven by dsh-routines — data lives in local SQLite (dsh plugin add @ttmouse/dsh-taskboard).

items.name: dsh-cron-job
items.desc: Scheduled DeepSeek Harness Agent tasks with mandatory end-to-end tests, run history, and bidirectional delivery through nine messaging channels.

items.name: dsh-automation-center
items.desc: Schedules workspace Agent runs in fresh Result Sessions with persistent audit history, using a stock DSH Conversation tab or a global Shell page when its slots are available.

items.name: dsh-outcome-loop
items.desc: Keeps a local task-outcome ledger for DSH, verifies acceptance criteria from deterministic evidence, records user disposition and token usage, and supports digest-bound export.

items.name: dsh-jev-subagent-dispatch
items.desc: Cut LLM costs: a Jev (System One) classifier vets each turn against a declarative policy and recommends the subagent model route, so routine work runs at flash rates while the main model keeps the hard parts; explicit /route trigger, runtime delegation-capability gate, credential redaction, and offline policy replay over the verdict log.

items.name: gitee-ai-employee
items.desc: Gitee/GitHub AI employee: @ the bot on an issue (Gitee or GitHub), it clones the repo, implements the fix on the branch you name, opens a PR to that branch, and can auto-merge and auto-close the issue. v1.2 adds security scanning: configure scan repos, audit with built-in/custom prompts, deduplicate, and file new findings as issues.

items.name: dsh-flow
items.desc: Execution flow chart: renders the current session's execution as a vertical node flow (turns, user, assistant, tools, approvals, retries, compaction), appended in real time over SSE with auto-follow scrolling — the chart draws wherever the session executes.

items.name: dsh-process
items.desc: Process management: brings ntd-style processes (multi-stage, multi-step agent workflow templates) into the dsh web UI — browse, edit, validate, import/export and AI-generate processes; the built-in library is read-only while the personal library is writable with live file sync, and agents read the library through process_* tools and advance work stage by stage.

items.name: dsh-tasks
items.desc: Scheduled tasks: run a prompt on cron schedules, each run opens a new agent session to do the work, with workspace binding, manual run, session auto-naming, and a fullscreen task management page.

items.name: dsh-thinktank
items.desc: Think tank: a built-in library of 161 classic mental models (decision/strategy/cognition/psychology/communication/learning/system/innovation/execution) — enter one question and several selected models analyze it in parallel via AI, producing a synthesized report with consensus, disagreements, blind spots and an action checklist; supports both automatic analysis and prompt round-trip import.

items.name: dsh-plugin-task-runner
items.desc: Task Runner mode for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent decomposes large tasks into independent subtasks, dispatches them to subagents (default local model) in fresh short contexts, and synthesizes results; concurrency and worker/orchestrator models are configurable in the settings panel.

items.name: dsh-round-table
items.desc: Round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows desktop, reusing existing Agent sessions with discussion, editable task cards, sequential and parallel steps, shared meeting files, and secretary minutes.

items.name: dsh-multi-candidate
items.desc: Multi-candidate mode for DeepSeek Harness (test-time scaling): floating panel config, the agent auto-runs parallel candidates plus verifier selection, scoped to the current session.

items.name: dsh-tandem
items.desc: Runs a second agent: hands independent subtasks to a local Codex CLI in parallel (up to three at a time), and asks it to review a design or a plan before the user sees it, returning conclusion, evidence, counterexamples and a verification step. A dispatch missing its timeout or its acceptance check is rejected by the plugin, not by the model remembering to check.

items.name: dsh-character-presets
items.desc: Luna preset for DeepSeek Harness — a little-demon persona on the full standard tool set, composed by six deterministic rule layers (perception, understanding, state, style, regulation, memory) plus a derived vitals layer, with a gated, suppressible cross-session memory file.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-wx-push
items.desc: Auto-send every DSH turn result to WeChat: listens for task completion, extracts the final assistant message and pushes it raw via the WeChat iLink bot (real delivery check, never fake success). Requires the wechat-acp daemon, a separately installed process you log into WeChat with.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-thesis-workbench
items.desc: Thesis and empirical-analysis workbench that drives IBM SPSS from the conversation: spss_check (environment self-check), spss_variables (list .sav variables with labels, types, measurement levels, case counts), spss_data (sample case rows to inspect missing and outlying values), spss_run / spss_run_file (execute SPSS syntax or an .sps file, relative CD and GET FILE paths auto-rebased), and spss_analyze (one-shot frequencies, descriptives, crosstabs with chi-square, t-tests, one-way ANOVA, correlation, linear regression). Results come back as structured tables extracted through OMS. SPSS 25-31 is auto-detected; the bundled MCP server is zero-dependency stdio.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-todo-guard
items.desc: Task-list staleness guard for DeepSeek Harness: watches the session event stream and counts tool calls since the last todo_write; past a configurable threshold it appends one short notice before the next step, quoting the current list, so the model writes it back to the real progress instead of leaving a stale snapshot on screen. Pure prompt injection, no blocking and no data mutation.

items.name: dsh-subagent-pool
items.desc: Maintains reusable named subagent profiles for DeepSeek Harness and runs them with per-profile model, reasoning effort, and agent-preset settings.

items.name: dsh-modes
items.desc: Settings page for agent modes (presets): switch up to 15 capabilities per mode (commands, files or read-only files, web, subagents, and more) or individual plugin rows; edit each mode's system prompt with variable checks, a full preview, version history, optional live updates for running sessions, and an approval-gated mode_prompt chat tool; create modes from four starter templates or copies; merge built-in updates after a dsh upgrade while keeping your changes, and turn off rows that fail to load.

items.name: dsh-root-planner-preset
items.desc: Recursive delegation for dsh agent trees: a preset plus Host limits bound what each subagent may do, subagents work in separate _agents/ workspaces, and the parent decides which results to integrate.

items.name: dsh-subagent-router
items.desc: Adds subagent_route and subagent_fork_route delegation tools where the model itself picks the provider/model route for each child; the deployment only sets the spawn/fork backend, background policy and allowedProviders allowlist, while continuable children and background jobs reuse the official send_message / job_output tools.

items.name: dsh-context-window
items.desc: Extends the composer model selector menu with a third Context window row, preset capacities (64K–2M), custom input, provider-wide sync, and adaptive compaction guard.

items.name: dsh-milestone-guard
items.desc: Milestone progress soft-enforcement guard: injects persistent system-prompt rules and post-execute notices when tool calls omit visible progress text, with a Web settings form.

items.name: dsh-md-convert
items.desc: Convert Office documents and PDFs (including scanned ones) to structurally formatted Markdown via a CPU-first routing OCR pipeline (RapidOCR/SLANet/FormulaNet).

items.name: dsh-expert-team
items.desc: Role-based multi-agent team for DeepSeek Harness — your digital workforce. One goal assembles a team of product, architect, frontend, backend, reviewer and QA roles that deliver through a nine-phase gated pipeline, plus a persistent team you can keep directing across sessions. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.

items.name: dsh-knj-scheduler
items.desc: Cron task scheduler for DSH: on schedule, automatically creates a new session and injects your prompt as its first message, with task history and manual run/stop controls. Also runs KNJ workflows: pick files directly (stored as persistent snapshots, re-handed to the workflow on every fire) or reference them by path. Its sidebar entry is provided by dsh-knj-menu; install together: dsh plugin add dsh-scheduler dsh-knj-menu.

items.name: dsh-knj-workflow
items.desc: Config-driven development-task orchestration for DSH: graph workflows (task/gateway/human nodes) with per-stage persistence, plus an in-editor AI assistant that configures workflows through conversation with live validation. Hand documents to nodes as generic attachments (no declaration needed): files land in the task workspace and ${inputs.附件} gives the newline-joined absolute paths, so a node parses them with its own prompt.

items.name: dsh-plugin-background-tasks
items.desc: Antigravity-style run_command for DSH: short commands return inline within a configurable wait window (default 10s) while longer ones auto-promote into ctx.jobs for later collection and completion notices — executed via ctx.shell under the session sandbox and approval pipeline.

items.name: dsh-agent-team-roster
items.desc: Agent Teams roster plugin: newest-first ordering for the roster, task board and subagent catalog, plus bulk cleanup and teammate rename/delete.

items.name: dsh-home-migrate
items.desc: Export and import DeepSeek Harness configuration across machines as same-OS .dshmig archives, with credential redaction, verification and rollback.

items.name: dsh-itranslation#bundle
items.desc: Whole-book translation production line for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic chapter detection and segmentation, per-chapter subagent translation, glossary control, full-book review, targeted revision, and auditable meta.json evidence.

items.name: dsh-nexus
items.desc: Personal coding assistant that schedules, follows up on and verifies local Codex or Claude Code tasks from DSH, with WeChat, WeCom and Feishu remote channels.

items.name: dsh-feedback-bridge
items.desc: Turns DSH conversations into reviewable community feedback and, after confirmation, submits it to the official DeepSeek Harness Discussions.

items.name: ai-company-framework
items.desc: AI Company Framework: turn one sentence into a multi-agent company — 15 flat Skills (boss/pipeline/role-template/11 roles/generic customer-memory), 7 workflow templates, AgentTeams runtime + activity panel, employee sidebar with per-session isolation, Feishu bot bridge (boss and per-employee bots, group routing, autonomous push, human decision gate, external-contact guide), per-customer SQLite memory with three-layer memory (cross-group merge), /company mode switch; no RAG.

items.name: alpharsi
items.desc: AlphaRSI — three-role self-improvement loop that evolves the training recipe of alpha sequence models. Operator runs walk-forward, Evaluator grades with OOS RankIC, Refiner proposes hyperparameters via TPE Bayesian search; only strictly-better recipes are kept. Offline one-command run, data bundle shipped with sha1 reconciliation, GPU auto-detect. Ships one skill.

items.name: attest
items.desc: Training attestation — reproducible, attributable, auditable off-site standardized training for asset pricing. Hard-gates four failure modes (half-refresh, hash mismatch, unknown-read-as-pass, master pollution). Ships one skill.

items.name: za_analysis
items.desc: Model training stage — end-to-end analysis, model training, and estimation for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.

items.name: za_data
items.desc: Data stage — data discovery and quality assessment for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.

items.name: za_literature
items.desc: Literature review stage — search, synthesis, and citation-chain tracking for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.

items.name: za_ppt
items.desc: PPT stage — presentation generation (Beamer/Quarto) from the paper for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.

items.name: za_report
items.desc: Report stage — academic paper writing for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.

items.name: zagent
items.desc: Zagent — unified three-role self-improvement loop with three operators. Data-RSI (daily cross-sectional cleaning: winsorize → cross-sectional standardization → median fill, plus experience extraction), Harness-RSI (evolves system prompt / memory / skills), and Model-RSI (evolves alpha training recipes via framework-native walk-forward with 2-day gap and multi-seed). Offline one-command run, GPU auto-detect. Ships one skill.

items.name: dsh-bot-mode
items.desc: Bot Mode for DeepSeek Harness: a roster of named bots with avatars, personas and per-bot chats, each backed by one durable continuable subagent session that keeps memory across turns.

items.name: dsh-agent-swarm
items.desc: Chinese multi-agent workflow with per-role model fallback, versioned Mermaid task plans, independent Agent and Jev reviews, persistent expert collaboration, and pure-function calculation tools.

items.name: dsh-programming-mode
items.desc: Programming Mode agent preset bundle: the standard coding agent with its persona mandating the Superpowers discipline (skills first, brainstorming before building, plans before code, TDD, systematic debugging, verification before completion) plus an always-on Ponytail code-volume discipline (7-rung minimal-code ladder, default full); ships all twenty skills bundled (14 superpowers + 6 ponytail) and mechanically injects the full using-superpowers skill into every new session's first request.

items.name: dsh-task-workspace
items.desc: Task workspace convention: one folder per session, one PROGRESS.md per task overwritten on each update, and per-task git once the task runs long.

items.name: dsh-crew
items.desc: Dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code or Codex: native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge for vision and image generation.

items.name: dsh-personal-todo
items.desc: Persistent personal todos shared across DeepSeek Harness sessions and projects: SQLite storage, Agent tools, a native sidebar and turn-tail cards, with user-managed workflows or optional dispatch of individual todos to Agent sessions.

items.name: dsh-workflow-ui
items.desc: In-conversation workflow run timeline for DSH Web: a horizontal rail with phase stations, agent pills, loop arcs and parallel bands replaces the stock workflow tool card and workflow-run chat node. Planned stations render before the run starts via client-side script scanning; status dots and icons follow DSH official primitives.

items.name: dsh-parallel-dev
items.desc: By default, blocks marking a team task complete without a passed independent verification record whose commit matches the worktree HEAD, and adds a dependency DAG board and a settings page.

items.name: dsh-ask-peer
items.desc: Peer-to-peer colleague-agent consultation for DSH: ask one or several configured peers, queue asynchronous questions, discover peers through signed friend cards, and review inbound requests in the Web UI.
